required_secrets.note: Read-only AWS credentials for the boto3 collector (SecurityAudit-level, config metadata only, no writes) with region scope on the envelope. The reference deployment uses static keys in its own account; a cross-account deployment swaps this entry's kind to aws_assumed_role (see the samsite plugin README + aws_core's handoff kit).
Fine-grained GitHub PAT, read-only (Metadata + Contents + Actions), scoped to only the signing repo(s) listed in the envelope's repos field. Administration read only if runner nodes are wanted.

description: Samsite demo — stand a fresh session up end-to-end: seed the plugin GRIFT (AWS/GitHub/KSI/samsite pages + schedules), then fire the collectors that pull the live world in. INSTALL SOURCES (eviction complete, 2026-07-09): the 8 evicted substrate/domain plugins install from their OWN repos at pinned immutable tags (type:git; all repos public since 2026-08-08 so installs are anonymous — a private fork names a credential per req-plugin-arch-source-secret-5) — identity_core/compliance_core @ v0.1.0 (new substrate repos), computing_core/roscale/aws_core/sigstore_core/github_core/fedramp_20x_ksi @ v0.2.0 (re-released with the substrate refactor). administrivia/lotr/samsite/grid_fixtures stay editable from the monorepo (samsite is evict-last; lotr + grid_fixtures are core-suite test vocabulary retained editable for test_all; administrivia is TAP admin). Seed order is INSTALLED_APPS order; collector order matters: samsite-compliance reads aws_account nodes (boto3) AND content-matches github_workflow nodes (github_core), so both must run before it. Install order lists substrate (identity_core, compliance_core) before its consumers so git-sourced dependency resolution finds them already installed, not on an index.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.administrivia). TAP admin pages + grid landing + cares administrivia; seeded in population.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.computing_core). Vendor-neutral computing-primitive dimension; seeded in population. Git-sourced from its own repo at v0.3.0 (public repo since 2026-08-08; anonymous git-install).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.roscale). Install-only: registers the OSCAL workbench panel types samsite consumes; no grift seed, no collector, but samsite imports it at ready() — must be installed. Git-sourced from its own repo at v0.2.0 (public repo since 2026-08-08; anonymous git-install).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.identity_core). Install-only substrate: cross-cutting federated-identity vocabulary (the oidc_issuer convergence node + issuer primitives) + the generic TRUSTS_ISSUER edge. github_core imports its issuer helper; sigstore_core/samsite reference identity_core__oidc_issuer. No GRIFT population seed. Git-sourced from its own repo at v0.1.0 (public repo since 2026-08-08; anonymous git-install).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.aws_core). Tier-0 boto3 dep. AWS dimension + region reference data; seeded + fired in population. Git-sourced from its own repo at v0.3.0 (public repo since 2026-08-08; anonymous git-install).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.sigstore_core). Tier-0 sigstore dep. Install-only library: samsite compliance_collector consumes its verify/decompose helpers + models; IDENTITY_VOUCHED_BY targets identity_core__oidc_issuer. Git-sourced from its own repo at v0.3.0 (public repo since 2026-08-08; anonymous git-install).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.github_core). Tier-0 PyYAML dep. AWS/GitHub Actions plumbing + the github collector; mints the oidc_issuer via identity_core and emits TRUSTS_ISSUER. Git-sourced from its own repo at v0.3.0 (public repo since 2026-08-08; anonymous git-install).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.compliance_core). Install-only substrate: regime-agnostic compliance vocabulary (artifact/context/evidence/finding/exception/boundary). samsite's compliance_collector creates compliance_core__compliance_artifact nodes; fedramp_20x_ksi depends on it. No GRIFT population seed. Git-sourced from its own repo at v0.2.0 (public repo since 2026-08-08; anonymous git-install).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.fedramp_20x_ksi). FedRAMP 20x KSI dimension, catalog seed, compliance/profile pages, schedule; seeded + catalog fired in population. Depends on compliance_core. Git-sourced from its own repo at v0.3.0 (public repo since 2026-08-08; anonymous git-install).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.samsite). The demo integration surface; seeded in population. DEPENDS ON compliance_core/github_core/identity_core/roscale/sigstore_core at import time + aws_core nodes at runtime — listed last so its cross-plugin deps install first. Its collectors ARE fired in this profile (pull the live world in).

Package-mode (tap_plugin.grid_fixtures). Install-only: the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the core suites build fixtures from. No GRIFT seed, no cross-plugin deps. (gryphon_playground, which depends_on it, is NOT installed in this customer-demo profile — the Gryphon test corpus stands up via its own in-package boot records selected by a bootstrap pointer.)

steps.note: TAP admin pages + grid landing + cares administrivia.
AWS dimension + region reference data the boto3 collector lands resources into.
Samsite keystone, landing + compliance pages, per-type viewers, and the collector schedules.
FedRAMP 20x KSI dimension, catalog seed, compliance/profile pages, schedule.
AWS resource graph (Route53/CloudFront/S3/Lambda/IAM/...) + the aws_account node the boundary membership depends on. A full multi-region pull can run well past the 90s default.
GitHub repository / Actions data behind the repo landing page.
Refresh the FedRAMP 20x KSI catalog (HTTPS, no credentials).

Signed /.well-known/ compliance artifacts (OSCAL SSP/POA&M, KSI signal, VDR). Fetches 5 artifacts + verifies sigstore signatures, so it gets a generous timeout. MUST run after boto3 (synthesizes SCOPED_TO_COMPLIANCE_BOUNDARY membership from the aws_account nodes) AND after github_core (sigstore_link resolves the signing github_workflow by content-match; if the workflow node isn't on the grid yet those edges are silently omitted).
